The disruption to the Strait of Hormuz has triggered the biggest energy supply shock the world has faced, with global oil supply falling by 16.1 million barrels per day at its peak. The International Energy Agency's World Energy Outlook 2026, released Thursday, examines the impact of the West Asia conflict on global energy markets and the vulnerabilities it has exposed.
India is particularly exposed, importing around 90 percent of its crude oil and 50 percent of its natural gas requirements.
